[SWS_SwCluC_02665] Serialization in Com_SendSignalGroup
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00211, SRS_SwCluC_00202
⌈The function Com_SendSignalGroup provided by the Com High Proxy shall
• perform a transformation from the original data passed from the RTE in Appli-
cation Software Cluster to the uint8 array,
AND
• invoke the Com_SendSignalGroupArray API to send the data as uint8 array
representation.
⌋
